{{Quote|I filched it, grabbed one of our courier ships, and headed for the rendezvous point Formbi had specified.''"<br />"''Only the ship didn't make it. [&hellip;] What happened?''"<br />"''The hyperdrive gave out in the Flacharia system. It would have taken me more than a week to repair it by myself [&hellip;]. Fortunately, at that point Car'das showed up again and offered me a lift.|Dean Jinzler and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>}}
The '''Flacharia system''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Dean Jinzler]] intercepted a message from [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]], an [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]], that was intended for the Human [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and was being transmitted through the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] communications relay post on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Comra/Legends|Comra]]. Jinzler took a [[Courier/Legends|courier]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] from the relay post and headed for the rendezvous point mentioned in the message.<ref name="SQ" />

However, the ship's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] broke down in the Flacharia system, leading Jinzler to think he would be stranded there for more than a [[Standard week/Legends|week]]. At that point, the Human [[Jorj Car'das]] arrived in the system in his own starship and picked Jinzler up, transporting him to the rendezvous point in the [[Crustai system/Legends|Crustai system]].<ref name="SQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Flacharia system was first mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="SQ" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square H-6.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
